faq.q: What does the name Aalimaht mean?
faq.a: Aalimaht means Learned woman (variant of ʿĀlimah).

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aalimaht?
What language does the name Aalimaht come from?
faq.a: Aalimaht is used in Arabic, Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aalimaht a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aalimaht is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aalimaht written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aalimaht is written عالمة in Arabic and عالمہ in Urdu, and आलिमा in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aalimaht?
faq.a: The root of Aalimaht is ع-ل-م (ʿ-l-m).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aalimaht?
faq.a: Transliteration variant of Arabic ʿālimah, from ʿalima, 'to know'.

faq.q: Does Aalimaht appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic personal name; ʿālimah is Arabic vocabulary from the root ʿ-l-m.

faq.q: Is Aalimaht the same as ʿĀlimah?
faq.a: Yes. 'Aalimaht' is a transliteration variant of ʿĀlimah (عالمة); the final -t is not part of the Arabic name.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aalimaht?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aalimaht total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aalimaht?
faq.a: Aalimaht appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Aalimah, Aalima.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aalimaht?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aalimaht include Aalimah, Aalima.

faq.q: Does Aalimaht mean the same as Aalima?
faq.a: Yes. Both render ʿĀlimah, the feminine of ʿālim, meaning 'learned woman'.

faq.q: Where is the name Aalimaht used today?
faq.a: Aalimaht is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
